dog.description_text:
What my friends at ACC say about me:

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I will need daily physical activity to keep me healthy and happy!

A Volunteer Wrote: It was an absolute joy to watch Winnie in the backyard, where he went from shy and wanting just to be close to his walker to his seeing other dogs out there and lighting up, play bowing and wagging his tail. If a dog can seem to ache for a calm place to lay his head again and a reason to be joyful, Winnie is one of them. Please come meet this lovely fellow and lead him back to a happy place!
dog.name: Winnie
